$reference..validate: newData.hasChildren(['reference', 'amount', 'currency', 'status', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('amount').val() === 44 && newData.child('currency').val() === 'USD' && (newData.child('status').val() === 'pending' || newData.child('status').val() === 'completed' || newData.child('status').val() === 'failed' || newData.child('status').val() === 'cancelled' || newData.child('status').val() === 'declined')
